title: No sympathy for Menga: [Ontario Edition]
article: A letter from Tina McCulloch, Toronto.
Let me get this straight. Police spot a Jeep that has been reported as stolen.
According to reports, when ordered to stop, the driver attempts to run down the officers. They shoot, killing the driver, John Menga.
Now Menga's family is dismissing his criminal history- he was through with drugs, claims his wife and seems to be blaming the police.
While I'm sorry for Menga's wife and two small children, I can only conclude nobody is to blame but him.
